text.p: Lithuanian European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said on Friday after a visit to Paris that French bank Societe Generale had told her it was interested in opening a branch office in Lithuania.
She also said that the Lithuanian embassy in Paris had informed her that other French banking giant Banque Nationale de Paris BNP.PA were also studying the Baltic state.

"Societe Generale, which has been knocking on the door of the Bank of Lithuania (the central bank) in seeking to open its branch office in Lithuania, is looking for premises and it is likely that this year they will open a branch office," Andrikiene told a news conference.
Societe Generale already has a branch in Latvian capital, Riga.
